title: Is Sara Omar the true author of D{\o}devaskeren (The Dead Washer)? Authorship attribution in Danish literature
abstract: arXiv:2611.34131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The bestseller D{\o}devaskeren (The Dead Washer) was published in 2017 under the name Sara Omar. A Danish colleague has suggested that the novel may have been written by another author, possibly Mads Peder Nordbo. To investigate this authorship question, four authorship attribution methods were applied, namely Delta, intertextual distance, Nearest Shrunken Centroids (NSC), and na\"ive Bayes. Using various parameter settings, these approaches consistently identify Nordbo's writing style in the doubtful novel, although the results do not provide conclusive evidence that he authored the novel in its entirety. In a second step, the novel was divided into non-overlapping segments of 5,000 tokens. Once again, Nordbo's style was identified in the majority of the segments. However, a small number of passages do not clearly support this conclusion and instead suggest the possible involvement of another, as yet unidentified, author, possibly Sara

translated_title: 萨拉·奥马尔是《洗尸者》的真正作者吗？丹麦文学中的作者归属研究
translated_abstract: 畅销书《洗尸者》于2017年以萨拉·奥马尔的名义出版。一位丹麦同行提出，这部小说可能是由另一位作者撰写的，可能是马德斯·佩德·诺德博。为了调查这一作者归属问题，研究者应用了四种作者归属方法，即Delta方法、文本间距离、最近收缩质心法和朴素贝叶斯。在多种参数设置下，这些方法一致地在存疑小说中识别出诺德博的写作风格，尽管这些结果并不能提供他撰写整部小说的决定性证据。在第二步中，小说被划分为互不重叠的5000词片段。同样地，大多数片段中识别出了诺德博的风格。然而，少数段落并不明确支持这一结论，反而表明可能还有另一位尚未确认的作者参与创作，可能是萨拉·奥马尔……
tldr: 本研究运用Delta、文本间距离、最近收缩质心和朴素贝叶斯四种作者归属方法，发现丹麦畅销小说《洗尸者》的大部分内容更符合马德斯·佩德·诺德博的写作风格而非署名作者萨拉·奥马尔，但少数段落暗示可能还有另一位作者参与创作。
